title: [rereview] project-LICHEN-zt3c.13: stale ULA/GUA reference in spec/03-adaptation.md line 71
description: Commit e9528d8e5 addressed stale ULA/GUA in 5 spec files but missed one: spec/03-adaptation.md line 71 still reads 'ULA/GUA with /64 prefix MSB match' for Rule 1 description. Should say '02xx with /64 prefix MSB match' (or 'mesh prefix with /64 prefix MSB match') to align with single-primary 02xx model. The same file's Rule 4 entry was correctly updated to '02xx' (line 74) but Rule 1 (line 71) was overlooked.
